gates.statement: Every number on #mission carries a mark and resolves to a raster read or an explicit absent state
gates.gate: emit_provenance.py — six assertions, each injection-tested

gates.statement: PSR, cold-trap overlap and illumination come from a horizon computation over the full LOLA array at a stated resolution
gates.gate: validate_psr_vs_lola.py — against the LOLA team's own published mask

gates.statement: Landing sites are the argmax of a six-criterion search over 14.9 M native cells with stated NMS and per-criterion evidence
gates.gate: search_landing_sites.py — plus the interpolation guard

gates.statement: The traverse is Dijkstra over a slope-and-hazard cost surface at a stated planning resolution, with UNREACHABLE a real state
gates.gate: plan_traverse.py — connectivity reported before any distance

gates.statement: CPR is an explicitly-labelled amplitude-only ratio with the claim withdrawn, and CANDIDATE AREA is a measurement including a zero
gates.gate: detection_statistics.py — the critical value, the table, and the withdrawn interval

gates.statement: The map's relief is real at 25 m, lit from more than one direction, and the base filter is set from a histogram rather than by eye
gates.gate: hillshade_histogram.py + composite_contrast.py

gates.statement: (same statement) the science layers composite over that relief without hiding it
gates.gate: composite_contrast.py — retention AND correlation with the base

gates.statement: The API and the static analysis agree on every terrain quantity they both report
gates.gate: assert_paths_agree.py — in-process, needs no server

gates.statement: Every measured figure quoted in METHODS.md still matches the artifact it was transcribed from
gates.gate: stamp_methods.py --check — 80 artifacts

gates.statement: The PDF report prints nothing the analysis artifacts do not contain
gates.gate: assert_pdf_agrees_with_analysis.py — the rendered bytes, not the inputs

gates.statement: A figure that is an upper bound is never quoted as if it were a rate
gates.gate: assert_upper_bounds_labelled.py — every occurrence, every tracked source

gates.statement: There is one incidence field, it satisfies incidence > look angle, and nothing consumes a field that does not
gates.gate: assert_incidence_geometry.py --only g12 — the identity, and every consumer

gates.statement: There is one CPR field and every consumer reads the same look count for it
gates.gate: assert_incidence_geometry.py --only g13 — read from the pipeline, not inferred

gates.statement: The production build mounts and renders against a backend that answers 200 and says it has no data
gates.gate: verify_production.mjs --all-states — the built bundle, all three backend states

gates.statement: A report is issued only on a host that holds the artifacts, and it names the state it was issued under
gates.gate: assert_pdf_refuses_without_rasters.py — the loader, the 409, the rendered bytes

gates.statement: The precomputed sweep discriminates on both axes, its axes are built from the measured field, and it agrees with the analysis
gates.gate: assert_sweep_grid_discriminates.py - agreement, measured axes, it moves, the crossing

gates.statement: The report's availability is measured at its own endpoint and never inferred from the mission endpoint's state
gates.gate: assert_report_state_is_its_own.py - independent, not derived, honest doc, probe works

gates.statement: A claim this project withdrew cannot reappear in a tracked source, and every scan term names a claim rather than a figure
gates.gate: assert_withdrawn_claims_absent.py --list prints each term with the sentence it forbids

gates.statement: The CPR/DOP degeneracy replicates on an independent acquisition and the measured crossing sits on the closed form
gates.gate: assert_degeneracy_replicates.py — 2020-03-05, a different orbit, look angle, PRF and grid

gates.statement: No interval is reported on the candidate area, the withdrawal is on the record, and the effective-sample count is read not copied
gates.gate: assert_wilson_on_effective_samples.py - no interval on a structural zero, 38,050 effective samples

gates.statement: The frame DEM's product and post spacing are read from its provenance file, and the horizon's remain distinct
gates.gate: assert_lola_product_agrees.py - two products, never confused

gates.statement: No document spells a count it could read from the thing it counts
gates.gate: assert_counts_are_read.py - gate count and apparatus failures, read not spelled

gates.statement: The Chandrayaan-2 bundle on disk is the product the manuscript names, and is internally coherent
gates.gate: verify_data_provenance.py - 7 checks, emits docs/data_provenance.json

gates.statement: The repository contains what the paper promises, and its history carries no data or secret
gates.gate: check_repo_complete.py - C1-C7, C7 scans every path ever committed

gates.statement: Every figure regenerates, embeds its fonts, and carries no Type 3
gates.gate: paper/assert_figures_embed_fonts.py - rebuilt, then read from the PDF itself

gates.statement: Every sensitivity claim in Sections V-VI is the number its artifact holds
gates.gate: assert_manuscript_claims.py - S1-S14, the CURRENT claims, not remembered digits

gates.statement: The amplitude-CPR ceiling survives shuffled, mis-scaled and random inputs, and no pixel passes in any case
gates.gate: robustness_gate.py - nine corruptions, crossing within 1e-4, zero passing

gates.statement: Every artifact with a stated reproduction command holds the number of runs that command produces
gates.gate: assert_artifact_matches_repro_command.py - the artifact is the run METHODS names

gates.statement: Every ENL ceiling is predicted from its own product's own label
gates.gate: assert_ceilings_have_own_label.py - no ceiling borrowed from another product

gates.statement: The literature-search record holds the counts the manuscript claims, and no relevant paper reports any of the three criteria
gates.gate: literature_search_gate.py - counts read from the screening CSV

gates.statement: Every cell of the manuscript's closed-form tables recomputes from the pipeline's own functions
gates.gate: recompute_manuscript_tables.py - Tables II, III and IV, cell by cell

gates.statement: The council analyses reproduce their anchors: the joint rule's size at N = 14, no significant joint selection below N = 79.6, and the F2 null's 86.3 % and 7.76 %
gates.gate: assert_council_anchors.py - recomputed from the stored cells, every arm
